SELECT json_build_object(
  'bookings', COALESCE((
    SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(bk.*) ORDER BY bk.event_date, bk.event_time)
    FROM (
      SELECT b.id, b.event_date, b.event_time, b.pickup_time,
        b.delivery_address, b.city, b.status, b.price,
        b.deposit_amount, b.deposit_paid, b.payment_status,
        c.name AS customer_name, c.phone AS customer_phone,
        COALESCE(
          (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('name', e.name, 'icon', e.icon, 'category', e.category))
           FROM batutynas.booking_equipment be
           JOIN batutynas.equipment e ON e.id = be.equipment_id
           WHERE be.booking_id = b.id), '[]'::json
        ) AS equipment
      FROM batutynas.bookings b
      JOIN batutynas.contacts c ON c.id = b.contact_id
      WHERE b.event_date >= ('{{ $('Parse Request').first().json.month }}' || '-01')::date
        AND b.event_date < (('{{ $('Parse Request').first().json.month }}' || '-01')::date + INTERVAL '1 month')
    ) bk
  ), '[]'::json),
  'stats', (
    SELECT json_build_object(
      'today_count', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM batutynas.bookings WHERE event_date = CURRENT_DATE AND status NOT IN ('Cancelled')),
      'week_revenue', (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(price), 0) FROM batutynas.bookings WHERE event_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 days' AND CURRENT_DATE AND status IN ('Completed','Delivered','Confirmed')),
      'unpaid_deposits', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM batutynas.bookings WHERE event_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '7 days' AND deposit_paid = FALSE AND status = 'Confirmed'),
      'available_equipment', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM batutynas.equipment WHERE status = 'Available')
    )
  ),
  'equipment', COALESCE((
    SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(eq.*) ORDER BY eq.category, eq.name)
    FROM (
      SELECT id, name, icon, category, status, last_cleaned
      FROM batutynas.equipment
    ) eq
  ), '[]'::json)
) AS result;
